# Nymira

> Private, prepaid API credits on NEAR. You deposit USDC once and spend it in short leases on attested models. The rest comes back to a payout account fixed at deposit. This deployment runs on NEAR testnet with Circle's test USDC. The proof circuits and the vault have had no independent review.

The web app and its documentation are one site: <https://nymira.pages.dev>. The documentation page is <https://nymira.pages.dev/#docs>. The code is at <https://github.com/nymiralabs/nymira>.

## Read first

- [README](https://github.com/nymiralabs/nymira/blob/main/README.md): what Nymira is, the live deployment, limits, the `nymirad` download, budget notes for agents
- [Guide for judges](https://github.com/nymiralabs/nymira/blob/main/JUDGES.md): a 20-minute path from a new wallet to a first answer and a close
- [Threat model](https://github.com/nymiralabs/nymira/blob/main/THREAT_MODEL.md): what the operator, the model provider, the RPC provider and the web host can see and do
- [Terms of use](https://github.com/nymiralabs/nymira/blob/main/TERMS.md)

## Reference

- [Web app notes](https://github.com/nymiralabs/nymira/blob/main/web/README.md): screens, storage, backups, set size
- [Release integrity](https://github.com/nymiralabs/nymira/blob/main/web/INTEGRITY.md): how a web release is signed and how to check it
- [MCP server](https://github.com/nymiralabs/nymira/blob/main/mcp/README.md): three tools for an agent that spends from a budget note
- [Vault contract](https://github.com/nymiralabs/nymira/blob/main/contracts/vault/src/lib.rs)
- [Pins](https://github.com/nymiralabs/nymira/blob/main/PINS.md): toolchain and dependency pins
